home.subtitle: Smart, fast, and 100% easy-to-use tools. Organize, convert, optimize, and supercharge your PDF documents with AI.
home.title: Every PDF tool you need in one place
home.trust_desc: ProjectAurora is your all-in-one web suite to process, optimize, and manage documents, images, and video with total ease. Enjoy every tool you need to work quickly and efficiently while keeping your data safe and secure.
home.trust_title: The software trusted by millions of users
home.tool_pdf_to_markdown_desc: Convert PDF documents into clean, structured Markdown (.md) files with Gemini AI in seconds.
home.tool_summarize_pdf_desc: Generate executive summaries, structured analyses, and key takeaways from PDF documents with Gemini AI in seconds.
home.tool_translate_pdf_desc: Convert PDF documents with AI into other languages while preserving the original layout. Fast, accurate, and ideal for business, education, or travel.
home.tool_image_compress_desc: Batch compress and optimize JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, and SVG images with maximum visual quality.
home.tool_remove_bg_desc: Remove the background from your images and photos automatically with artificial intelligence in seconds.
home.tool_upscale_image_desc: Multiply the resolution and sharpness of your photos and images up to 4x with AI super-resolution.
home.tool_pdf_to_jpg_desc: Convert every page of your PDF file into high-resolution JPG images or extract images.
home.tool_pdf_to_word_desc: Convert PDF documents to editable DOCX Word files with maximum precision.
home.tool_pdf_to_powerpoint_desc: Turn your PDF presentations into editable PowerPoint PPTX slides.
home.tool_pdf_to_excel_desc: Extract tables and structured data from PDF files directly into Excel XLSX spreadsheets.
home.tool_pdf_to_pdfa_desc: Convert PDF documents to the ISO PDF/A standard for long-term legal archiving.
home.tool_jpg_to_pdf_desc: Convert JPG, PNG, or WebP images into high-quality PDF documents.
home.tool_word_to_pdf_desc: Convert Word DOCX and DOC documents to PDF files while maintaining formatting and tables.
home.tool_powerpoint_to_pdf_desc: Transform PowerPoint PPTX and PPT presentations into PDF documents.
home.tool_excel_to_pdf_desc: Convert Excel XLSX and XLS spreadsheets into structured PDF tables.
home.tool_html_to_pdf_desc: Convert web pages and HTML files into PDF documents with exact layout.
home.tool_merge_pdf_desc: Combine and reorder multiple PDF documents into a single file quickly and easily.
home.tool_split_pdf_desc: Extract pages, define custom ranges or split your PDF by file size into separate documents.
home.tool_extract_pdf_pages_desc: Extract selected pages from your PDF document into a new or independent file.
home.tool_remove_pdf_pages_desc: Remove unnecessary pages from your PDF document visually and quickly.
home.tool_organize_pdf_desc: Reorder pages in your PDF by dragging them and rotate individual pages as needed.
home.tool_rotate_pdf_desc: Rotate your PDF pages permanently by 90, 180 or 270 degrees individually or in bulk.
home.tool_page_numbers_desc: Add page numbers to your PDF documents with custom positioning, margins, and formatting.
home.tool_crop_pdf_desc: Crop PDF page areas to trim margins or remove unnecessary white space.
home.tool_watermark_pdf_desc: Add custom text or image watermarks to your PDF documents with custom position, opacity, and rotation.
home.tool_edit_pdf_desc: Add text, images, shapes, freehand drawing, and edit native text in your PDF documents.
home.tool_compare_pdf_desc: Compare two PDF documents side by side, detect semantic text differences and view changes with ease.
home.tool_compress_pdf_desc: Reduce the file size of your PDF while maintaining the best possible quality.
home.tool_repair_pdf_desc: Repair and recover data from corrupt or damaged PDF documents.
home.tool_ocr_pdf_desc: Recognize text from scanned PDF documents to make them searchable and selectable.
home.tool_protect_pdf_desc: Protect your PDF documents with passwords and strong encryption to prevent unauthorized access.
home.tool_redact_pdf_desc: Permanently redact and remove sensitive information, text or entire pages from your PDF.
home.tool_unlock_pdf_desc: Remove passwords and security restrictions from your PDF files to use them freely.
